_note: Geolocation stand-ins for the RFC 5737 / TEST-NET addresses used by the bundled corpus. The corpus deliberately never contains a real IP, so without this map the geolocation feature has nothing to resolve in DEMO_MODE and the trace map renders empty - which reads as a broken feature rather than a safe one. Every value here is invented. resolve_ip() stamps source='fixture' on anything returned from this file, and the UI, the PDF and the JSON all display that provenance, so a fixture location can never be mistaken for a MaxMind lookup. Ignored entirely unless DEMO_MODE is on: in real mail a documentation range in a Received header IS a forged header, and the analyser should keep saying so.
_alignment: Keys, hostnames and country hints match RELAY_POOL in scripts/make_corpus.py. If a relay is added there, add it here too or its hops resolve as 'unavailable'.
